features.text: Top Rated by Consumer Reports
See how LG Front Load Washers were rated on reliability, performance, and energy & water efficiency.
Power Clean Big Loads in Under 30 Minutes
5 powerful jets spray clothes from multiple angles for a complete clean in under 30 minutes.
Deep Clean with the Power of Steam
AAFA certified LG washers with the Allergiene™ Cycle remove over 95% of pet dander and dust.
Cold Wash Without Compromise
ColdWash™ technology penetrates deep into fabrics, for cold water savings with warm water performance.
More Style, Less Space
LG closet-depth washers have a shallower depth to fit in more places and add sleek style to any room.
Smooth Surface Helps Prevent Snags
Unlike porcelain and plastic, LG's stainless steel tub avoids chips that snag on & ruin clothing.
Measure First, Order Right.
Nothing is more frustrating than an appliance that doesn’t fit. We’ll help you find the right one for your space.
Built-in Intelligence Takes Out The Guesswork
AI technology selects optimal wash or dry settings. Washer can auto-select a compatible drying cycle.
Life's better when your home runs smart
Discover ThinQ Care within the ThinQ app -- proactive smart alerts to keep your appliances running smoothly. Get notifications about usage, maintenance, plus early diagnosis right on your smartphone.
Save Time and Wash Fewer Loads Every Week
Bring on big loads of towels or jeans -this ultra large (4.5 cu. ft.) washer fits more in every load up to 20 lbs.
Wash Two Loads at The Same Time
Wash small loads that can't wait or two loads at once with the LG SideKick™ Pedestal Washer.
